issue_context.title: Can not get the TxnStart if the SQL has a non-related subquery.
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```sql
create table t (i int, j int);
select 1, (select sleep(count(1) + 10) from t);
-- select * from information_schema.processlist\G in another session
```

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

```
mysql> select * from information_schema.processlist\G
*************************** 1. row ***************************
      ID: 2199023255955
    USER: root
    HOST: ::1:61116
      DB: test
 COMMAND: Query
    TIME: 3
   STATE: autocommit
    INFO: select 1, (select sleep(count(1) + 10) from t)
  DIGEST: 8f73da58fef747a698844eeaff36c543611c15a87cea02aae446b67c4e2e4ccc
     MEM: 6680
    DISK: 0
TxnStart: 01-30 14:46:11.046(439107235622682624)
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```
*************************** 1. row ***************************
      ID: 2199023255955
    USER: root
    HOST: ::1:61116
      DB: test
 COMMAND: Query
    TIME: 3
   STATE: autocommit
    INFO: select 1, (select sleep(count(1) + 10) from t)
  DIGEST: 5f387f371befa8d6d7be925432a3ba40b0a0e8468e29fbe3f4815d9a9498cb21
     MEM: 6680
    DISK: 0
TxnStart:
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
v5.0.0 ~ 28d0325ae12f080b978a147bba9f8467557019cd
<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
comments: I think it is caused by . When the optimizer tries to evaluate some rows in subqueries, it doesn't set start tso to TxnContext.

review_comments: We could comment on why the `UpdateProcessInfo` should be called here.
